name: Serif body/heading font stack
definition: Check whether headings and body text use a generic serif stack (e.g. Georgia, Times New Roman, serif) instead of a sans-serif.
note: Original font files were not in the prompt, so the generator picked its own fonts; counted as a possible signature (user decision).

name: Inter / system-ui sans font stack
definition: Check whether the font-family stack is Inter and/or system-ui/sans-serif with no custom brand or webfont.
note: Original font files were not in the prompt, so the generator picked its own fonts; counted as a possible signature (user decision).

name: Moderate H1 size (about 60-64px)
definition: Check whether the desktop H1 font-size is roughly 60-64px, smaller than an oversized display headline.

confound.reason: The original used an unusually large 76px H1, so the difference is partly the original's choice.

name: Conventional 16-17px base body size
definition: Check whether the body base font-size is 16-17px rather than an oversized value.

confound.reason: Original used an oversized 23.2px body, so the contrast reflects the original more than a generator trait.

name: Light/regular heading weight
definition: Check whether section headings use regular or light weight rather than heavy bold display weight.

name: Small regular-weight testimonial quote text
definition: Check whether testimonial quotes are set at body size (about 15-17px) in regular weight rather than as large bold pull-quotes.

name: Bold em-dash testimonial attribution
definition: Check whether testimonial attributions use bold (or accent-colored) name text with a leading em-dash.

name: Em-dash attribution prefix
definition: Check whether attribution lines begin with an em dash followed by a space ('— Name, Title') rather than a hyphen.

name: Small light-grey social-proof caption
definition: Check whether microcopy under the hero CTA is small and light grey with reduced contrast.

name: Uniform solid underlined accent-colored links
definition: Check whether inline links are uniformly solid-underlined in the accent color.

name: Highlighter-style yellow underline on links
definition: Check whether inline links use a thick yellow highlighter-like underline or background strip.

name: Reduced-size closing CTA headline
definition: Check whether the closing call-to-action text is small, single-line body-like text rather than a large display heading.

name: Muted italic footer copyright
definition: Check whether the footer copyright/closing line is italic in a muted color.

name: Generous vertical spacing between footer link rows
definition: Check whether footer link rows are stacked with large vertical gaps.

name: Warm cream page background
definition: Check whether the body or hero background is a warm off-white/cream (e.g. around rgb(251,248,241)) instead of pure white.

name: Alternating full-width section background bands
definition: Check whether consecutive sections alternate full-width background colors (cream, white, sage, dark) to separate content.

name: Green accent palette
definition: Check whether the primary accent used for CTAs, links and highlights is a green hue.

confound.reason: Brand recolor from yellow to green; could be generator preference or arbitrary choice.

name: Green-tinted near-black text color
definition: Check whether body text color is a tinted dark (green or slate) rather than neutral black.

confound.reason: Original also used a tinted navy, so only the hue differs.

name: Dark solid footer with light text
definition: Check whether the footer has a dark (green or navy) solid background with light text.

name: Saturated full-width yellow feature band
definition: Check whether a section sits on a full-width saturated yellow background band.

name: Sage-green section band behind white cards
definition: Check whether a muted sage/grey-green section background hosts white cards.

name: Dark filled primary CTA
definition: Check whether the primary CTA is a dark filled (green or navy) button with white text.

name: Pill-shaped (fully rounded) CTA buttons
definition: Check whether CTA buttons use a fully rounded pill shape (border-radius around 999px).

name: Plain-text Sign in beside filled pill nav CTA
definition: Check whether the header shows an unbordered text 'Sign in' link next to a filled pill CTA.

name: Roomier constrained-width header
definition: Check whether the header sits inside a max-width container with generous padding and spacing.

name: Logo as circular badge icon plus wordmark
definition: Check whether the logo is a round badge icon next to a wordmark.

confound.reason: Logo asset may come from generator's re-creation of brand material.

name: Logo as external img file, not inline SVG
definition: Check whether the header logo is an img element referencing an .svg file instead of inline SVG.

confound.reason: Asset handling depends on the supplied files and pipeline.

name: Review quotes in white rounded chips/cards
definition: Check whether review-star snippets are wrapped in white rounded cards or chips.

name: Enlarged star ratings with extra spacing
definition: Check whether rating stars are large (yellow) and spaced out in a row above the headline.

name: Testimonials as white rounded card grid
definition: Check whether testimonials are rendered as white cards with rounded corners in a multi-column grid.

name: Masonry columns with uneven heights
definition: Check whether card columns have staggered start positions or uneven heights (masonry).

name: Column-wise reading order from masonry
definition: Check whether card content order flows down the left column then the right, breaking row-wise reading.

name: Featured first card with highlight treatment
definition: Check whether the first testimonial card is visually emphasized (colored outline, fill or larger size).

name: Colored left accent border on cards
definition: Check whether cards have a thick colored left border accent.

name: Before/After comparison as two side-by-side colored-label cards
definition: Check whether a before/after comparison is split into two side-by-side cards with colored (red/green) labels.

name: Secondary action rendered as plain text link
definition: Check whether a secondary action (e.g. 'learn more') is a plain underlined text link rather than a bordered button.

name: Dark filled secondary button
definition: Check whether a secondary action is a dark filled button.

name: Book/product cover with drop shadow or tilt
definition: Check whether a product image has a drop shadow, card frame, or slight tilt.

name: Hero screenshot framed in a shadowed card
definition: Check whether the product screenshot sits in a bordered or shadowed card container.

name: Hero image abruptly cropped instead of faded
definition: Check whether the hero image ends with a hard crop rather than a fade or blend into the background.

name: Two-column image-left, text-right sections
definition: Check whether content sections use a two-column split with image on the left and copy on the right.

name: Left-aligned headings and body copy
definition: Check whether section headings and paragraphs are left-aligned rather than centered.

name: Max-width constrained content with wide margins
definition: Check whether content is held in a max-width container with wide side margins.

name: Compact page height with tighter vertical rhythm
definition: Check whether total page height and section spacing are compact relative to a spacious layout.

confound.reason: Original has very large type and whitespace; difference is partly derived from that.

name: Uniformly rounded corners across components
definition: Check whether most buttons, cards and containers share rounded corners.

name: Soft drop shadows on cards and buttons
definition: Check whether cards and buttons use subtle box-shadow for depth.

name: Thin straight grey section dividers
definition: Check whether sections are separated by thin straight grey rules instead of decorative dividers.

confound.reason: Original used a hand-drawn squiggle, so this mainly reflects the missing brand art.

name: Flat straight-edged bands without organic shapes
definition: Check whether section transitions use flat straight-edged bands rather than organic or torn-paper shapes.

confound.reason: Original's hand-drawn blobs and torn edges were absent from the regeneration.

name: Handwritten annotation overlays colliding with UI
definition: Check whether hand-lettered annotations on the hero image overlap UI or other text.
note: Image roles were deliberately not described in the prompt; misplaced overlay images are recorded as a possible signature (decision 2026-10-11).

name: Extra duplicate hero illustration asset
definition: Check whether the page loads additional illustration images beyond the original's set.

confound.reason: Image set depends on assets supplied to the generator.

name: Footer chart image cropped with truncated labels
definition: Check whether a footer illustration is cropped or oversized so its labels are cut off.

name: Decorative image as faint low-contrast background
definition: Check whether a large illustration is used as a faint low-contrast background texture on a dark section.

name: Footer illustration omitted
definition: Check whether the footer has no illustration or chart, only text links.

confound.reason: Omission of the original's hand-drawn growth chart.

name: Pale green tinted footer background
definition: Check whether the footer sits on a pale tinted green background.

name: Local relative image paths
definition: Check whether images are loaded from local relative file paths instead of a CDN.

confound.reason: Reflects the generation and rendering pipeline.

name: Lean self-contained document with minimal scripts and meta
definition: Check whether the document has zero or few script/link tags and a minimal head (about 2 meta tags, 1 title).

confound.reason: Original's script overhead came from archived tracking and site code.

name: Testimonials marked up as figure/blockquote/figcaption
definition: Check whether testimonials use figure, blockquote and figcaption elements rather than blockquote plus cite.

name: Single H1 element
definition: Check whether the page has exactly one h1.

name: Simplified responsive picture/source sets
definition: Check whether picture elements have fewer source elements.

name: Fewer anchors and simplified link set
definition: Check whether the link count is reduced and content is mostly paragraphs.

name: Footer links as paragraphs/spans instead of lists
definition: Check whether footer links are marked up with p/span instead of ul/li.

confound.reason: Evidence is an inference from tag counts.

name: Fewer form inputs and labels
definition: Check whether the page omits search or form input/label elements.

confound.reason: Original had a search input that was not reproduced.

name: Added italic emphasis on key word
definition: Check whether copy adds italic emphasis on a single word, such as 'quick'.

name: Round-number social-proof statistic
definition: Check whether social-proof stats use round numbers (e.g. '4,000') instead of precise figures.

name: Rewritten generic benefit-style document title
definition: Check whether the page title is rewritten into a generic benefit-style phrase (e.g. 'The All-In-One Toolkit for ...').

name: Generic footer sign-off replacing date-specific copy
definition: Check whether footer sign-off text is generic ('Enjoy the rest of your day!') rather than dynamic or date-based.

name: Hero star-quote snippets inline in a single row
definition: Check whether review snippets sit inline in one horizontal row with stars at left of each.
